stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 28 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G019】比较结构、拉丁比较级（superior/prior to）与比较维度限定（in terms of）；【G024】适度名词化（Nominalization）、复杂名词短语与动词活力平衡。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP023】六级与雅思托福（CET-6 / IELTS / TOEFL）议论文：去模板化“主张—机制—具体实例—让步”结构，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 比较结构、拉丁比较级（superior/prior to）与比较维度限定（in terms of）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 科学比较必须做到：(1) 比较主体语法同构，(2) 明确比较指标与条件（in terms of / with respect to / under comparable conditions），(3) 正确使用拉丁比较级与类比结构。
rules: superior to, inferior to, prior to, analogous to, akin to 一律用介词 to，严禁用 than。
声明某方法更优（superior / optimal / outperform）时，必须限定评估指标与数据集范围，禁止无条件宣称“处处最优”。
examples: The method was superior to the baseline on this metric, but other outcomes were not assessed.
The procedure is akin to stratified sampling, although the allocation rule differs.
The two protocols differ with respect to measurement error.
common_errors: 省略比较基准（baseline）或评价维度。

grammar_instruction.name: 适度名词化（Nominalization）、复杂名词短语与动词活力平衡
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 名词化可将前句的过程浓缩为后句主语（如 The relaxation of this assumption...），实现紧凑衔接；但绝不能认为“名词化越多越学术”，过度名词化会导致句子僵化、头重脚轻。
rules: 用“The + 派生名词 + of + 核心对象”打包已知过程作主语，谓语仍使用清晰有力的动词（The elimination of duplicate entries reduced the file size）。
当主语和宾语都已是长抽象名词时，中间谓语直接用强动词（affects, constrains, clarifies），不要写 *conducts an influence on。
examples: The emergence of new devices changed the monitoring procedure.
The quantification of uncertainty is central to this analysis.
common_errors: 僵尸名词堆砌（Zombie Nouns）：*The implementation of the reduction of parameters was carried out（应直接写 We reduced the number of parameters）。

grammar_instruction.name: 让步反驳（Concession-Rebuttal）、局限性陈述与外推边界（Extrapolation Limits）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 顶会论文 Limitations 章节、Rebuttal 及高分议论文的核心技能：坦诚承认方法或样本的约束条件（acknowledge constraints），同时清楚界定在什么范围内结论依然稳健（robust），并指出何时外推（extrapolation）会失效。
rules: 区分内插（interpolation，在已观测范围内估计）与外推（extrapolation，向观测年龄、工况或分布范围外推断，需更强假设）。
用 While / Although / Despite 承认局限，用 nevertheless / aún / provided that 说明受控范围内的有效性与后续改进方向（warrant further investigation）。
examples: Extrapolation beyond the observed age range requires additional justification.
The discrepancy warrants further investigation, but it does not warrant a causal conclusion.
common_errors: 要么完全隐瞒局限，要么自相矛盾地声称局限毫无影响。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 六级与雅思托福（CET-6 / IELTS / TOEFL）议论文：去模板化“主张—机制—具体实例—让步”结构
expression_pattern_instruction.template: While [Concession: competing view/cost], [Main Claim: policy/technology] can [Verb: facilitate/mitigate] [Outcome] by [Concrete Mechanism], as illustrated by [Specific Real-World Case].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 专为六级、雅思 Task 2 与托福独立写作设计：告别陈腐套话，用一句话完成让步对比，紧接着给出具体作用机制与可信实例。
examples: While expanding public transport requires substantial infrastructure investment, subsidising bus fares can facilitate access to education for low-income students by reducing daily commuting costs.
Asynchronous online courses allow working adults to study at their own pace; nevertheless, they cannot wholly replace face-to-face seminars that stimulate spontaneous debate.
common_errors: 只写夸张口号（如 *Online education is a double-edged sword and plays a vital role*）而不展开具体原因机制与实例。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 精确区分可数样本量与不可数开销/证据
expression_pattern_instruction.template: While a large number of [plural countable nouns] were collected, the procedure required only a small amount of [uncountable noun].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在数据集与实验开销描述中准确搭配可数与不可数量词。
examples: A large number of records still require checking.
The protocol requires a small amount of additional information.
common_errors: *a great deal of participants / *an amount of records。
